info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Pharmacy Prescriptions Transfer-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Transfer API enables the seamless transfer of prescriptions between pharmacies, ensuring that patients receive their medications without interruption. This API provides endpoints to manage the prescription transfer process, allowing for tracking and updating necessary details during the transfer. Common use cases include pharmacy operations and healthcare provider interactions, assisting in maintaining accurate patient medication records. By utilizing this API, pharmacies can enhance their service efficiency and improve patient satisfaction.

put.summary: Transfer a prescription to a different pharmacy.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to transfer an existing prescription from one pharmacy to another, facilitating easier access for patients. Ensure that the prescription details and the new pharmacy's information are correctly provided in the request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to transfer prescriptions between different systems or locations. Please ensure that the necessary prescription details and identifiers are included for a successful transfer.
